entities.summary: Nenad Dimitrijević is a North Macedonian professional basketball player for Bayern Munich of the Basketball Bundesliga (BBL) and the EuroLeague, on loan from Zenit Saint Petersburg. He is also a regular member of the North Macedonia national team.
